BL_NULL.description: Expected IC under null hypothesis of no predictability

BL_MOMENTUM.description: Model with only momentum features (no volatility regime)
BL_MOMENTUM.rationale: Tests whether volatility features add value beyond momentum

BL_VOL_BINARY.description: Model with binary volatility regime (from exploratory)
BL_VOL_BINARY.rationale: Tests whether VOL_ZSCORE improves over VOL_BINARY

comparison_requirements.incremental_value: VOL_ZSCORE model must exceed BL_MOMENTUM IC
comparison_requirements.representational_improvement: VOL_ZSCORE model must exceed BL_VOL_BINARY IC (secondary)

baseline_selection_policy.rationale: Baselines must be pre-registered to prevent cherry-picking
